game_of_the_week.default_criteria: Pick the most compelling upcoming matchup based on records, standings position, and head-to-head history.

week_overrides.1: It's the season opener — prioritize a rematch of a playoff game from last year, or a clash between prior season champions. If neither of those are scheduled, then find the matchup that is the most consistent (close to split record, close average scores against each other, etc).
week_overrides.2: If any of the four highest scoring teams are facing each other, then highlight that game. If that doesn't occur, then check to see if the highest scoring team from week one is also playing someone who is 1-0. If that doesn't exist, then check to see if there are any matchups thare are a repeat of a playoff game from last year. If that doesn't exist, then pick the worst two 0-1 teams.
week_overrides.3: Focus on the top 5 ranked teams and if they are playing each other. Prioritize total W% of the combined teams as the tiebreaker to select. If that doesn't happen, then focus on any team ranked in the top 5 who has an opponent who could upset them, so anyone outside the top 5 in record, but may be top 5 in points scored, or someone who isn't in the top 5, but has a really hard schedule difficulty.
